title: Browsing context's container doesn't seem to be set anywhere
body:
In `completely finished loading a Document`, there is a spec note that reads:
> 3. Let container be document's [browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#concept-document-bc)'s [container](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#bc-container).

> This will be null in the case where document is the [initial about:blank](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#is-initial-about:blank) [Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#document) in a [frame](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#frame) or [iframe](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-iframe-element), since at the point of [browsing context creation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#creating-a-new-browsing-context) which calls this algorithm, the container relationship has not yet been established. (That happens in a subsequent step of [create a new nested browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#creating-a-new-nested-browsing-context).)

However, in [create a new nested browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#creating-a-new-nested-browsing-context), there is no step that set's the browsing context's container:
> 1. Let group be element's [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)'s [browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#concept-document-bc)'s [top-level browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#top-level-browsing-context)'s [group](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#tlbc-group).
> 2. Let browsingContext be the result of [creating a new browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#creating-a-new-browsing-context) with element's [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document), element, and group.
> 3. Set element's [nested browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#nested-browsing-context) to browsingContext.
> 4. If element has a name attribute, then set browsingContext's [name](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#browsing-context-name) to the value of this attribute.

I had a look through all the references to `container` in the HTML spec and I can't find a step that sets it, so it ends up always null.
